# Completion Checkpoint

Use at the end of a bounded slice to report factual status. See `docs/development/VALIDATION_GATES.md` (completion gate) and `docs/development/DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md`. Do not use this as permission to start the next slice automatically.

## Scope

What was requested, and the exact bounded slice actually attempted.

## Status

Use this project's accepted status vocabulary from `VOCABULARY.md` if one exists. If none exists, state the factual state in plain language (for example: implemented and verified, implemented but unverified, partially implemented, blocked) rather than inventing a controlled vocabulary here.

## Contracts and decisions touched

List accepted contracts, ADRs, or vocabulary entries this slice depends on or affects. Note any proposed-but-not-accepted material consulted.

## Files changed

List changed or created files with a one-line reason each.

## Security and data impact

Note any sensitive-data handling, sanitization directives applied, or exclusions observed.

## Checks run

Exact commands and exact results. Do not report a check as passed if it was not run.

## Gaps and deferred work

What was intentionally left out of scope, and why.

## Rollback

How to revert this slice if needed.

## Next bounded task

Recommend one next task. Do not begin it.
